caption: The video captures an extreme close-up of a glass window pane densely covered with water droplets of varying sizes. Several thin vertical streaks of running water trace down the surface, their wavy edges frozen in place across the entire excerpt. Behind the glass, a heavily blurred background of bright overcast sky and indistinct dark green foliage provides a soft, out-of-focus backdrop. The framing remains completely fixed, with no pan, tilt, or zoom altering the composition from the first frame to the last. Within this segment, none of the droplets slide, merge, enlarge, or vanish, and no new drop arrives to disturb the pattern. The streaks stand as evidence of earlier downward flow, yet no active movement is visible, leaving the water appearing at rest. The scene holds its quiet, rain-soaked texture steadily throughout the clip.
